summary: Sprint 7C.2 (AI News, Calendar, Summary, Analytics) backend validation + full regression. New comprehensive suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter30_ai_news_analytics.py — 50/50 PASSED (100%). Every new endpoint (news list/detail/filters, calendar meta/list/filters/CRUD, summary get/history/generate/delete, analytics overview/by-symbol/by-timeframe/history/tick, admin console) returns 200 with correct shape. Datetime handling is clean (all ISO strings, no offset-naive/aware errors). Broadcaster produced market_news notifications on startup as designed. Full regression re-run of iter27 + iter28 (71 tests): 70 PASSED, 1 pre-existing failure unrelated to Sprint 7C.2 (TestAlertsTrigger.test_eval_loop_triggers — same alerts_engine.price_above cross-detection bug documented in iteration_27.json). No Sprint 7C.2 regression on wallet, notifications, auth/me, forex, market, market_providers, copy_trading, ai_intelligence, or kyc.

minor.issue: TestAlertsTrigger.test_eval_loop_triggers still fails — alerts_engine price_above/below only triggers on cross (needs last_price < target <= price). Since last_price is snapshotted at creation to current market price, an alert with target=0.0001 never fires. Documented RCA in iteration_27.json; NOT introduced by Sprint 7C.2.

action_items: OPTIONAL (pre-existing, iter27): Fix alerts_engine.price_above/below cross-detection so alerts fire when target is already crossed at creation. Not blocking Sprint 7C.2.
critical_code_review_comments: ai_news/routes.py — clean separation of user vs admin dependencies (get_current_user vs get_current_admin), Pydantic-validated request models, proper HTTPException codes.
ai_news/calendar_engine.py — correctly handles offset-naive datetimes by replacing tzinfo=UTC before arithmetic (lines 168-184), preventing the 500 error mentioned in task brief.
ai_news/news_engine.py & summary_engine.py — gracefully degrades when EMERGENT_LLM_KEY missing by falling back to deterministic templates with is_ai_generated=False. Verified via response schema.
routes.py admin_console — computes pending_broadcast and upcoming_events counts on-the-fly; not cached (fine for admin dashboard, low traffic).
MongoDB _id is properly excluded via projection {'_id': 0} everywhere in ai_news module.
All datetimes serialized via .isoformat() before returning.
